sources.title: Official household survey
sources.content: Released 2030-04-08. Employed residents of the wider Riverton metro fell from 200000 to 196000 between March 2029 and March 2030. Measures people, including self-employed residents, regardless of workplace.

sources.content: Establishment jobs and employed residents differ in population, geographic boundary, unit and reference period. These figures cannot be averaged into a common growth rate. No harmonized series is available.

SUMMARY OF FINAL RESULTS: Over the first full year, cycling trips on the corridor rose 31% compared with 2028, and recorded injury collisions fell from 18 to 11. These are final figures; no later revision is planned. The remaining sections document methods and appendices.
